readmeMarkdown:
# Codex Bridge **An Antigravity plugin with an interactive control panel, persistent goal & milestone board, auto-callback progression loop, and zero-dependency MCP bridge to orchestrate your local OpenAI Codex CLI.** [![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-1.5.0-7c3aed?style=flat-square)](./plugin.json) [![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D18.0.0-22c55e?style=flat-square)](https://nodejs.org/) [![Dependencies](https://img.shields.io/badge/dependencies-zero-0ea5e9?style=flat-square)](#architecture) [![MCP](https://img.shields.io/badge/protocol-MCP%20Stdio-f59e0b?style=flat-square)](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-64748b?style=flat-square)](./LICENSE) **English** · [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md)
--- ## Why Codex Bridge? **Codex Bridge** turns your local **OpenAI Codex CLI** into a persistent, goal-driven coding & analysis worker inside **Google Antigravity** — built specifically for iterative workflows like **backend debugging/refactoring** and **meta-analysis / data pipelines** that require continuous investigation, execution, and verification. - Let **Antigravity** analyze requirements, design verifiable milestones, inspect diffs, and verify outcomes. - Let **Codex** execute edits, run backend tests/scripts, resume multi-turn sessions, and wake Antigravity automatically when background runs finish. ## Features - **Mastermind + Worker Role Division (`orchestrator` / `flexible`)** — Defaults to **Mastermind Mode**: Antigravity leverages its strengths in text synthesis, specification writing, lightweight tools/plugins, and stage verification, while delegating all heavy coding, backend debugging, and data/meta-analysis script execution to Codex in a closed callback loop (`codex_start` with `conversation_id`). - **Native Interactive Sidecar Panel (EN / 中文)** — Appears right inside Antigravity's **Plugins** side-pane menu with one-click live **English / Chinese** switching and two clean tabs (**Controls** & **Goals & Jobs**): - **Model selection** (auto-populated from your local `~/.codex/models_cache.json`) - **Reasoning effort** (dynamically adapts to each model's supported levels: `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, `max`, `ultra`) - **Progression mode** (switchable live): - `manual` — No automatic callbacks; wait for your next prompt. - `notify` — Automatically wakes Antigravity when a background Codex job finishes so it can verify and report findings. - `autonomous` — Automatically verifies completed milestones, calls `codex_resume` on failure, or advances to the next pending milestone until done (guarded by a configurable `maxAutoIterations` cap and one-click **Pause** button). - **Sandbox policy** (`read-only`, `workspace-write`, `danger-full-access`) & **Briefing workflow** (`direct` vs. `plan_first`) - **Persistent Goal & Milestone State Machine** — Goals, ordered milestones, verification commands, blockers, and linked `Session ID`s persist on disk (`goals.json`), surviving conversation compaction and restarts. - **Per-Job Locked Callbacks & Explicit Retry** — Callback targets (`conversationId` / `projectId`) are locked from trusted Antigravity host context at job dispatch time (`GET /api/state` is strictly read-only, preventing cross-conversation leaks). Failed deliveries remain visibly marked `failed` with one-click retry strictly to the original source conversation. - **Restart-Resilient Jobs & Cross-Process Session Locks** — Background jobs (`codex_start`) persist to `jobs.json` with atomic per-session file locks (`locks/`). If the MCP server restarts while a Codex process is still alive, the job transitions to `running_detached` (blocking duplicate spawns until it finishes or is explicitly stopped). Structured resume (`resume_job_id` or panel **Resume Job**) preserves original `session_id`, `cwd`, `sandbox`, `goal_id`, and `milestone_id`, places `-C` / `-s` before `resume`, and blocks accidental sandbox widening unless explicitly confirmed. - **Automatic Codex Discovery** — Automatically locates the newest `codex.exe` bundled with Codex Desktop on Windows (survives hash-folder auto-updates), falls back to `codex` on `PATH`, or respects `CODEX_BIN`. - **Zero External Dependencies** — Pure Node.js ESM (`>= 18`). No `npm install`, no build step, instant startup, UTF-8 `stdin` prompting. ## Architecture ```mermaid flowchart LR User["User in Antigravity"] <--> Agent["Antigravity Agent"] User <--> Panel["Sidecar Control Panel & Goal Watcher
(sidecars/codex_panel)"] Panel -->|Auto-Callback on Job Done| Agent Panel <--> Store["Persistent State
(settings.json / goals.json / jobs.json)"] Agent <-->|MCP Stdio JSON-RPC| Server["Codex MCP Bridge
(server/mcp-server.js)"] Store <--> Server Server <-->|JSONL Stream + UTF-8 stdin| Codex["Local OpenAI Codex CLI
(codex exec / resume / review)"] ``` ## Quick Start ### Prerequisites - **Google Antigravity** (Desktop or CLI) - **Node.js `>= 18`** - **OpenAI Codex** (Codex Desktop app or `codex` CLI installed and signed in) ### Install **macOS / Linux:** ```bash git clone https://github.com/yeyuhants-prog/codex-bridge.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/codex-bridge ``` **Windows (PowerShell):** ```powershell git clone https://github.com/yeyuhants-prog/codex-bridge.git "$env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins\codex-bridge" ``` ### Enable & Open the Panel 1. Open **Skills & Customizations** (自定义扩展) in Antigravity's left sidebar and ensure **Codex Bridge** is toggled **ON**. 2. Open the interactive control panel from the right-hand **Plugins** (`插件`) menu → **Codex Bridge**. 3. Pick your **Codex model**, **reasoning effort**, **progression mode** (`manual` / `notify` / `autonomous`), and **sandbox** — each new job binds its callback when dispatched. Conflicting request and host conversation IDs are rejected. ## MCP Tools (9) | Tool | Description | | --- | --- | | `codex_goal` | Create, inspect, update milestones, pause/resume, or delete persistent multi-step Goals shared with the Sidecar goal board. | | `codex_run` | Run a task synchronously via `codex exec` using active panel settings (or per-call overrides). Supports optional `goal_id` & `milestone_id`. | | `codex_resume` | Continue by `resume_job_id` or an exact session UUID. Unknown sessions default to read-only. | | `codex_review` | Run Codex's built-in non-interactive Git code review (`uncommitted`, `base` branch, or `commit` SHA). | | `codex_start` | Launch a persistent background Codex worker and return `job_id` immediately; triggers auto-callback upon completion in `notify`/`autonomous` modes. | | `codex_status` | Inspect progress events, `Session ID`, or final output of a background job (including restart-interrupted jobs), with optional `wait_seconds` long-polling. | | `codex_cancel` | Terminate a running background Codex job along with its child process tree. | | `codex_config` | Read or update shared preferences (`model`, `reasoning_effort`, `sandbox`, `workflow_mode`, `progression_mode`, `max_auto_iterations`) and list local Codex models. | | `codex_info` | Health check showing resolved Codex binary & version, active panel settings, bound conversation, active goal progress, and tracked jobs. | ## Example Prompts - **Continuous backend debugging:** > *"Create a persistent Codex Bridge goal to reproduce the 500 error in `backend/auth`, fix the root cause, and pass `pytest`. Start milestone 1 in the background and keep verifying until all tests pass."* - **Iterative meta-analysis pipeline:** > *"Set up a goal with milestones for cleaning the dataset, checking heterogeneity (I² / Q-test), running sensitivity analysis, and exporting forest plots. Dispatch Codex step-by-step and verify each output table."* - **Code review:** > *"Have Codex review my uncommitted Git changes in this repository and summarize bugs or edge cases."* - **Per-call model override:** > *"Use `gpt-6.2-astra` with `xhigh` reasoning effort and have Codex refactor the parser module."* ## Environment Variables | Variable | Default | Purpose | | --- | --- | --- | | `CODEX_BIN` | Auto-discovered | Explicit path to the `codex` / `codex.exe` binary. | | `CODEX_HOME` | `~/.codex` | Directory containing Codex's `config.toml` and `models_cache.json`. | | `CODEX_BRIDGE_DATA_DIR` | `~/.gemini/antigravity/plugin_data/codex-bridge` | Directory storing `settings.json`, `goals.json`, `jobs.json`, and `history.json`. | ## Testing ```bash # Zero-token MCP protocol, settings & persistent goal board smoke test npm test # End-to-end live check against your local Codex CLI (read-only, ephemeral) npm run test:live ``` Structured resumes retain the parent directory, session, goal, callback destination and execution policy. A milestone override must belong to that goal. A cross-conversation panel resume returns HTTP 409 until the caller selects `keepOriginalCallback: true` or `transferCallback: true`. MCP callers can explicitly transfer with `transfer_callback: true`. The child records the previous destination in `transferredFrom`. Expanding writable directories or sandbox permissions requires boolean `allow_sandbox_escalation: true`. ## Project Structure ```text codex-bridge/ ├── plugin.json # Antigravity plugin manifest ├── mcp_config.json # Portable MCP server definition ├── assets/ │ └── logo.png # Plugin icon (512×512 transparent PNG) ├── server/ │ ├── mcp-server.js # Zero-dependency MCP Stdio JSON-RPC server │ ├── codex-runner.js # Codex CLI auto-discovery, spawn & JSONL parser │ ├── goal-store.js # Persistent Goal & Milestone state machine │ ├── job-manager.js # Persistent async worker & process-tree manager │ └── settings-store.js # Shared preferences, history & model catalog reader ├── sidecars/ │ └── codex_panel/ # Native Antigravity side-pane UI & callback watcher │ ├── sidecar.json │ ├── main.mjs │ ├── index.html │ ├── app.js │ └── styles.css ├── skills/ │ └── codex-worker/SKILL.md # Orchestration skill for Antigravity ├── rules/ │ └── AGENTS.md # Active rules while plugin is enabled └── test/ └── smoke-test.mjs # End-to-end MCP smoke test ``` ## License Released under the [MIT License](./LICENSE).
